content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably we need to get 1H NMR spectrum and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but no args). The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it.
